modal.title: Settings
modal.subtitle: Tune gameplay, visuals, audio, and multiplayer defaults.

gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.skipLowUsePriorityWindowsDescription: Automatically pass your own empty-stack upkeep, draw, and end-step priority windows. Phase stops and Full Control still pause.
gameplay.nativeEngine: Use native engine for local games and hosted multiplayer
gameplay.nativeEngineDescription: Use the downloaded engine for local AI games and games you host through a lobby. Guests still connect through the lobby's peer-to-peer connection. Falls back to the built-in engine when unavailable.

visual.title: Visual
visual.showOpponentBoard: Show opponent's board on HUD hover
visual.cardPreviewDelayHint: Wait this long after hovering a card before the preview appears.

cardPreviewHint.follow: The enlarged preview follows your cursor as you hover a card.
cardPreviewHint.side: The preview docks to the edge of the screen so it never covers the board.
cardPreviewHint.shift: The preview only appears while you hold Shift, like Tabletop Simulator.

visual.draftCardPreviewHint: Applies only while drafting and building your draft deck.
visual.cardPreviewFooterHint: Includes the card name, available activated abilities, and keyboard hints. Alt still opens parse details when this is hidden.

flexLayout.title: Flex Layout
flexLayout.description: Drag panels and HUDs anywhere, and resize the board zones.
flexLayout.hint: Drag any panel to move it. Drag the glowing bars to resize zones.

layout2.label: Layout 2
layout2.description: A larger battlefield with tucked-away hands.

multiplayer.title: Multiplayer
multiplayer.serverSelectionNote: Server selection moved to the lobby — open Multiplayer and use the server chip (or "Pick server" in P2P mode) to switch regions, configure a self-hosted instance, or test connectivity.

sync.title: Cloud Sync
sync.description: Sign in to sync your decks, preferences, and feed subscriptions across devices. Your data lives in your account and updates automatically whenever it changes.
sync.statusPaused: Cloud sync is paused while you're offline.
sync.conflictBody: This device and your cloud account both have data and we can't tell which is current. Choose one copy, or keep both deck collections.
sync.savesNote: Game saves and caches stay on this device.

data.title: Backup & Restore
data.description: Export bundles your preferences, imported decks, and feed subscriptions into a single JSON file. Import restores them on another machine. IndexedDB caches (feed cache, audio cache, saved games) are not included — those rebuild automatically.
data.importModeMessage: Replace everything with the backup (destructive), or merge — keep existing decks and add new ones from the backup.
data.importConfirm:
Overwrite existing preferences and decks?

OK: replace everything with the backup (destructive).
Cancel: merge — keep existing decks, add new ones from the backup.
data.telemetryDescription: Helps fix crashes and prioritize card support. No account, no personal data — just error and game-summary counts.

visualPacks.title: Offline card images
visualPacks.description: Choose images to keep on this device. The card catalog is cached from Scryfall; every image is then downloaded directly from Scryfall.
visualPacks.offlineUnavailable: Network downloads are unavailable while offline. Reconnect to update the catalog or install, sync, repair, or resume images.

availability.browser: This browser does not provide the local storage features required for offline image downloads.
availability.browserFuture: Use a current desktop browser with Cache Storage, IndexedDB, and gzip decompression support.
availability.unsupported: This desktop app is too old to manage offline visual catalogs. Update the app to continue.
availability.empty: Load the current Scryfall card snapshot to choose offline images.
availability.invalid: The local card snapshot could not be read. Refresh it before continuing.

selector.title: Download selection
selector.curatedNote: One image per card, chosen by your Card Art Preferences on the Visual tab. Change them there and this selection follows.
selector.curatedDefaultNote: One image per card. You have no card art rules, so this downloads each card's default art — add rules under Card Art Preferences on the Visual tab to pick different printings.
selector.deckLibraryNote: One image per card used in the shared deck library, including AI Commander precons. It follows Card Art Preferences. After installation, the app updates additions and removes images no longer needed while it is running; removing this pack stops that synchronization.
selector.driftNone: Your installed images already match these settings.
selector.driftSummary: Your installed images are out of date: {{add}} to add, {{remove}} to remove, {{refresh}} to refresh.
selector.invalidSet: Enter a valid three-to-six character set code.

estimate.title: Scryfall snapshot scan
estimate.headroomWarning: This is larger than the free space this browser reports. You can still install it — if space runs out the download can be resumed, and it keeps everything already saved.
estimate.evictionWarning: This browser has not granted persistent storage, so it may delete these images when the device runs low on space.
estimate.progress: {{downloaded}} MB of {{total}} MB read · {{records}} cards scanned · {{images}} images found

operation.title: Current operation

states.terminated: Stopped — this operation cannot be resumed

operation.scanNote: The total grows as the Scryfall snapshot is scanned. Completed images are stored locally and skipped when you resume.
operation.estimateNote: The total was fixed when this download started. Completed images are stored locally and skipped when you resume.

persistenceState.persisted: Granted — this browser will keep these images
persistenceState.best_effort: Not granted — this browser may delete these images when the device runs low on space

issues.receipt_metadata: Receipt metadata differs from the trusted catalog
issues.dependency_drift: Installed dependency records differ from the trusted catalog
issues.projection_drift: Installed lookup records differ from the trusted catalog

cleanup.malformed_entry: A malformed cache entry could not be reclaimed
cleanup.unsafe_entry: An unsafe cache entry was left untouched
cleanup.remove_failed: A cache file could not be removed
cleanup.catalog_state: Historical catalog state could not be reclaimed

errors.unsupported_shell: This app version does not support offline visual catalogs.
errors.unauthorized: This window is not allowed to manage offline visual catalogs.
errors.unavailable: Offline image downloads are unavailable in this browser.
errors.invalid_input: The requested catalog selection is invalid.
errors.conflict: This selection is out of date: the catalog or your art preferences changed after it was made. Estimate it again, then retry.
errors.network: The Scryfall catalog or image download failed.
errors.storage: The catalog could not be written to device storage.
errors.insufficient_storage: Not enough free space: this download needs at least {{required}}, and only {{available}} is free.
errors.trust: The downloaded image could not be verified locally.
errors.emit: The app could not report catalog progress.
errors.internal: The catalog operation could not be completed.

confirm.cascadeMessage: Other installed packs depend on {{selection}}. Remove the frozen selection and its dependents?
confirm.completeMessage: Remove every installed pack from catalog root {{selection}}?
confirm.allMessage: Remove all installed visual packs from this device?

resetAll.confirm: Reset all preferences to defaults? This clears every setting in this dialog.

pacing.title: Pacing
pacing.animationSpeedDescription: Master speed — higher is faster. Full-right skips animations entirely.
pacing.hint: Per-category sliders multiply on top of Animation Speed. Double-click any slider — or tap the <glyph>↺</glyph> next to it — to reset.

descriptions.effects: Spell casts, zone changes, deaths, life changes, counters, tap/untap.
descriptions.combat: Combat damage timing — how long blockers and attackers linger before damage resolves.

offlinePreparation.title: Offline preparation
offlinePreparation.description: Prepare this desktop for cold-launch local play before enabling Work Offline.
offlinePreparation.visualWarning: Installed visual packs need attention. Open Visual Packs to repair them; local play remains available.

states.needs-preparation: Prepare this device before working offline.
states.ready: This device is ready for offline local play.
states.failed: Some required local-play capabilities are not ready.
states.reconnect-required: Reconnect before preparing offline local play.
states.reload-or-relaunch-required: Reload the app or relaunch the desktop shell, then prepare again.

artChain.emptyState: Using default Scryfall art. Add rules below to customize.
artChain.unreachable: Rules below "{{rule}}" are unreachable — it always matches.
artChain.rulesPriorityNote: Rules are tried top-to-bottom. The first match wins. “Source Printing” uses the set from a draft pack or deck import when available. Per-card overrides (right-click in deck builder) always take priority.
